src.label: Maldives Customs Service — prohibited and restricted items for import (pets)

head: Dogs are strictly prohibited; other pets need a vet health certificate.
lines: Maldives Customs lists pets as a restricted item. A health certificate from an authorised veterinarian, confirming the animal is free from infectious or contagious disease, is required.
The same entry states that the import of dogs and other dangerous animals is strictly prohibited, so a dog cannot be brought in with the usual paperwork.

The page gives no rabies vaccination rule, microchip rule or quarantine period, and it separately says live plants and animals need a valid phytosanitary or sanitary certificate and Ministry of Fisheries and Agriculture inspection.
